tagline: Cuts your clips to the rhythm of a reel you love
brief: An open-source desktop studio for solo creators worldwide. It studies a reel you love and cuts your own phone footage to its beat and structure. The identity should feel rhythmic, warm, confident and crafted, and stay far from CapCut's black-and-white look.
criteria: Distinct among creator and media apps, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, carries the four accent colours the app uses.

concepts.name: Avartan
concepts.idea: One rhythm cycle in four beats: each beat's weight follows its accent, and the gaps between them are the cuts.
rationale: Carries both halves of the name: the cycle is the taal, the gaps are the cut
Four arcs hold the app's four accents: marigold, rose, violet and teal
A small-size drawing keeps every cut open at 16 px
Moves naturally: the arcs can pulse to the beat in onboarding and render progress

next_steps: Use the two-colour version day to day; keep the four-colour version for the app icon and brand moments
Commission a professional trademark search in each launch market before public beta
Apply the icons in the Electron build and the website head (see kit/web/head-snippet.html)
